## Failure mode and why it matters

Who or what is affected? Use a fictional or sanitized example, not live exploit details.

## When this check applies

Describe architecture, exposure, workload, and prerequisites. When is it NOT NEEDED?

## Evidence and disconfirmation

What would confirm the problem? What compensating control could disprove it?

## Safe verification

Can it be reviewed read-only? If active tests are needed, describe isolation, synthetic data, authorization, and limits.

## Minimum remediation and placement

What is the simplest useful response? Which prompt phase, checklist item, guide, or report field should change?
